record-assignment.title: Record assignment rules
record-assignment.intro: Give new {contacts}, companies and {deals} to the right sales owner automatically.
record-assignment.crossNote: This assigns {contacts}, companies and {deals}. To assign conversations to agents, see <link>Auto-assignment</link>.

master.title: Turn on record assignment
master.hint: Off until you turn it on. When it is on, the rules below give a new {contact}, company or {deal} that has no owner to someone on your team.

imports.title: Also assign imported records
imports.hint: Off by default so a large import does not change who owns what.

ownerRule.title: Only records without an owner are assigned
ownerRule.body: An owner a person set is never replaced, and neither is an owner someone cleared on purpose. The engine fills an empty owner on a new record. If you turn on Reassign on update for a rule, it may also move a record that the engine itself assigned earlier, as long as nobody has changed the owner since.

how.title: How priority works
how.p1: Rules are tried from priority 1 downwards. The first rule that matches and finds someone available takes the record.
how.p2: Only active rules are prioritised. A paused rule keeps its place in the list but never runs.
how.p3: A rule with no conditions matches every record and runs after all the other rules, wherever it sits in the list. This is the fallback.
how.p4: A record that matches several rules goes to the one with the highest priority.
how.p5: Drag a row, or use its arrow buttons, to change the order. Fallback rules and paused rules stay in their own group at the bottom.

list.readOnly: You can see these rules but not change them. Changing them needs the permission to manage record assignment.

empty.title: No rules yet
empty.contact: New {contacts} keep whatever owner they are created with.
empty.company: New companies keep whatever owner they are created with.
empty.deal: New {deals} keep whatever owner they are created with.

list.fallbackHint: A rule with no conditions matches every record and runs after all the other rules.
list.brokenConditions: {count, plural, one {# broken condition} other {# broken conditions}}
list.brokenHint: A condition points at something that was deleted. It matches nothing until you fix it.
list.usedCount: {count, plural, =0 {Never used} one {Used # time} other {Used # times}}

hint.round_robin: Takes turns between the people, in a steady order.

least_busy.contact: Gives it to the person who owns the fewest {contacts} right now.
least_busy.company: Gives it to the person who owns the fewest companies right now.
least_busy.deal: Gives it to the person who owns the fewest open {deals} right now.

hint.fixed: Always the same person. While they are on leave, their delegate takes over.

editor.name: Rule name
editor.moduleLocked: A rule's module cannot be changed. Create a new rule for another module.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.hint: A record matches when its fields meet the conditions. Pick a field, then how to compare it, then a value.
conditions.emptyTitle: No conditions: matches every record, runs last (fallback)
conditions.emptyBody: This rule takes every record that no other rule took. Add a condition to narrow it down.
conditions.partial: Some fields could not be loaded. You can still build rules with the ones that did.

assign.title: Assign to
assign.teamsNote: A team here is a pool of people to choose from. A record does not belong to a team: its owner is one of the team's members.
assign.skipOfflineHint: People on leave are always skipped.
assign.reassign: Reassign when an update makes this rule start matching
assign.reassignHint: Applies only to records this engine assigned itself, and only while nobody has changed the owner since. Off by default: a record is assigned once.

problems.name: Give the rule a name.
problems.people: Choose at least one person or team.
problems.fixedOne: A specific-user rule needs exactly one person and no teams.
problems.conditions: Fix the highlighted conditions before saving.

editor.unsavedMessage: Your changes to this rule have not been saved.

test.title: Test with a record
test.hint: Choose a real record and see which rule would take it and who would get it. Nothing is changed, and it works while the switch is off.

search.contact: Search {contacts} by name, email or phone

test.searchFailed: The search did not work. You may not be allowed to see these records.
test.failed: The test did not run. Try again.
test.off: Record assignment is off, so this shows what would happen if it were on.

outcome.would_assign: {record} would go to {owner} through the rule {rule}.
outcome.disabled: Record assignment is switched off for this workspace, so nothing would happen.
outcome.has_owner: {record} already has an owner, so no rule would run. An owner someone set is never replaced.
outcome.nobody_available: A rule matches {record}, but everyone it names is on leave, offline or no longer here.
outcome.plan: Your plan does not include record assignment rules.
outcome.not_found: That record was not found. It may have been deleted, or it is outside what you can see.

log.title: Run log
log.intro: What the engine did with each record, newest first. Entries are kept for {days} days and hold ids only, never the contents of a record.
log.loadFailed: The run log did not load.

reason.raced: The owner changed while it was being assigned
reason.unchanged: It is already with the right rule

toast.cloned: Rule copied. The copy is paused.
toast.conflict: Someone else changed this rule. The latest version is loaded. Check it and apply your change again.

delete.title: Delete this rule?
delete.message: The rule {name} will stop assigning. Records it already assigned keep their owner.
